name: Inmate Admissions
description:
This dataset records individual inmate admissions to a correctional facility, with 5,000 sampled rows and seven columns. Each row represents one admission event, identified by an inmate ID, along with the date and time of admission and, where applicable, the discharge date and time. Roughly 55% of records have no discharge date, indicating inmates still in custody or whose release was not recorded. The data also includes demographic attributes (race and gender) and an inmate status code, with "DE" (detained) being the most common at 75% of records, followed by smaller shares of codes such as DPV, CS, DEP, and SSR. A top charge field captures the primary offense or statute cited at admission, though it is missing for about half of the rows; where present, values include penal and vehicle/traffic law codes.

The data could support analyses of admission volumes over time, length of stay (by comparing admission and discharge timestamps), demographic composition of the inmate
